projects.title: vLLM-Bench-App — LLM Benchmarking Platform
projects.description: A lightweight web GUI for vLLM-Bench that automates Hugging Face model downloads, vLLM server deployment, sequential benchmark execution, optional SLURM-based HPC execution, and interactive visualization of LLM inference performance metrics.

projects.title: PageIndexWithVLLM — Local Vectorless RAG
projects.description: Local document Q&A system that builds a hierarchical section tree from PDFs and answers questions by reasoning over that structure — no embeddings, no vector database, everything runs on your own machine.

projects.title: HPC Job Monitoring AI
projects.description: FastAPI backend enabling engineers to debug failed Slurm jobs through a persistent AI chat interface with per-job conversation history, auto-resolution tracking, and dynamic summaries powered by a local LLM.

projects.title: AI ATS System
projects.description: AI-driven Applicant Tracking System for resume parsing, candidate scoring, and recruitment insights with vLLM, FastAPI, and Streamlit.

projects.title: RetrieverAI
projects.description: RAG-based document-aware conversational AI with LangChain, vLLM, and ChromaDB, enabling chat with documents in Streamlit UI.

projects.title: Retina-AV-Segmentation
projects.description: Deep learning pipeline for retinal artery-vein segmentation from fundus images using Multi-Class Attention U-Net.

projects.title: Bramhanetra — Ancient Text OCR
projects.description: Recognized ancient Bramhi script using InceptionResNetV2, aiding in digitizing and preserving historical Indian inscriptions.

projects.title: Agricultural Consulting System
projects.description: Web-based advisory system integrating ML models for crop & fertilizer recommendation and plant disease prediction using YOLO.

publications.title: A Comprehensive Introduction to LLM Fine-Tuning Techniques
publications.description: Full breakdown of fine-tuning approaches — from full fine-tuning and adapters to LoRA, QLoRA, and quantization — with intuitive explanations and real memory numbers.

publications.title: From Words to Understanding: How the Attention Mechanism Powers Modern AI
publications.description: A deep dive into the attention mechanism — from RNN limitations to transformers, covering Q/K/V, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and layer norm with worked examples.

workshops.title: Data Science & Deep Learning Learning Guide
workshops.description: Beginner-to-advanced notebooks covering data science fundamentals, machine learning algorithms, deep learning basics, and mathematical foundations — with hands-on coding exercises throughout.

workshops.title: Distributed Deep Learning Workshop
workshops.description: Hands-on workshop content covering distributed deep learning on GPUs: GPU offloading, PyTorch DDP, Accelerate DDP, PyTorch FSDP, and Accelerate FSDP.
